description: DTDL v2 schema for the System Resource MetricTypes: cpu, memory, disk, network, system. Each Telemetry corresponds to one (MetricType, MetricName) pair. Network sensors support v1.1 Sensor Expansion via Parameters.Interface (bound) or Parameters.Interfaces (list / auto-detect). schemas[] publishes reusable Enums + typed Parameters Object per MetricType; every Telemetry's comment carries its validation rule.

schemas.description: Allowed MetricType discriminators in this Interface.
Allowed values of Parameters.MetricName when MetricType == 'cpu'.
Allowed values of Parameters.MetricName when MetricType == 'memory'.
Allowed values of Parameters.MetricName when MetricType == 'disk'. Each disk sensor must also set Parameters.MountPoint.
Allowed values of Parameters.MetricName when MetricType == 'network'.
Allowed values of SensorGroup. System-resource sensors conventionally use 'SYS'.
Allowed values of SensorInfo.Schema; must additionally match the Telemetry's native DTDL schema.
Reusable Object schema for the Parameters block of every cpu Sensor in devicecfg.json. CPU sensors take no type-specific extra parameters.
Reusable Object schema for the Parameters block of every memory Sensor in devicecfg.json. Memory sensors take no type-specific extra parameters.
Reusable Object schema for the Parameters block of every disk Sensor in devicecfg.json. Disk sensors require Parameters.MountPoint.

fields.name: mountPoint
fields.description: Filesystem mount path to monitor (e.g. '/'). Required; defaults to '/' if omitted by the agent.

schemas.description: Allowed values of Parameters.MetricName when MetricType == 'system'.
Reusable Object schema for the Parameters block of every system Sensor in devicecfg.json. System sensors take no type-specific extra parameters.
Reusable Object schema for the Parameters block of every network Sensor in devicecfg.json. Field names are camelCase; on-the-wire keys are PascalCase (the agent matches case-insensitively).
schemas.comment: DTDL v2 lacks union types and cross-field constraints. Two runtime rules live outside this schema and are enforced by dtdl-validate/scripts/config-rules.js: (1) 'interfaces' may also appear on the wire as a CSV string; (2) 'interface' and 'interfaces' are mutually exclusive when both non-empty.

fields.name: interface
fields.description: Single OS-level interface name. v1.0 mode: required. v1.1 mode: optional; when set disables expansion.

fields.name: interfaces
fields.description: Array of OS-level interface names. v1.1 only. Each entry expands to one sensor sharing the parent Telemetry DTMI. Empty array => auto-detect.

contents.name: CpuUsage
contents.description: Overall CPU busy % across all cores (0.00-100.00). MetricType=cpu, MetricName=usage.
contents.comment: Validation: 0 <= v <= 100 (rounded to 2 dp); reject NaN / +-Inf as sensor faults; sustained v > 95 for >= 5 min indicates saturation. Unit: percent.

contents.name: CpuLoad1
contents.description: 1-minute load average from /proc/loadavg. MetricType=cpu, MetricName=load1.
contents.comment: Validation: v >= 0; unitless; v > 2 * nproc for >= 5 min indicates sustained overload. Returns 0.0 on non-Linux platforms.

contents.name: CpuLoad5
contents.description: 5-minute load average from /proc/loadavg. MetricType=cpu, MetricName=load5.
contents.comment: Validation: v >= 0; unitless. Same overload threshold as CpuLoad1.

contents.name: CpuLoad15
contents.description: 15-minute load average from /proc/loadavg. MetricType=cpu, MetricName=load15.
contents.comment: Validation: v >= 0; unitless. Same overload threshold as CpuLoad1.

contents.name: CpuContextSwitches
contents.description: Cumulative scheduler context-switch count since boot (/proc/stat ctxt). MetricType=cpu, MetricName=context_switches.
contents.comment: Validation: monotonic counter; 0 <= v <= 2^63-1; delta(v) >= 0 between samples; resets only on reboot. Always graph as rate.

contents.name: MemoryTotal
contents.description: Total physical RAM. MetricType=memory, MetricName=total.
contents.comment: Validation: v > 0; constant across uptime (modulo hot-plug).

contents.name: MemoryAvailable
contents.description: Memory grantable without swapping (incl. reclaimable cache). MetricType=memory, MetricName=available.
contents.comment: Validation: 0 <= v <= MemoryTotal. Prefer over MemoryFree for memory-pressure alerts.

contents.name: MemoryUsed
contents.description: Memory currently used (total - available). MetricType=memory, MetricName=used.
contents.comment: Validation: 0 <= v <= MemoryTotal; used + available = total.

contents.name: MemoryFree
contents.description: Kernel's free-list size, excludes cache. MetricType=memory, MetricName=free.
contents.comment: Validation: 0 <= v <= MemoryTotal. Small MemoryFree alone is NOT a problem on Linux.

contents.name: MemoryCached
contents.description: Page cache. MetricType=memory, MetricName=cached.
contents.comment: Validation: 0 <= v <= MemoryTotal. Large sudden drops indicate memory pressure.

contents.name: MemoryBuffers
contents.description: Buffer cache. MetricType=memory, MetricName=buffers.
contents.comment: Validation: 0 <= v <= MemoryTotal.

contents.name: MemorySwapTotal
contents.description: Total swap capacity. MetricType=memory, MetricName=swap_total.
contents.comment: Validation: v >= 0; 0 is normal for embedded / containerised hosts.

contents.name: MemorySwapFree
contents.description: Free swap capacity. MetricType=memory, MetricName=swap_free.
contents.comment: Validation: 0 <= v <= MemorySwapTotal. Active swap-in/out indicates exhaustion.

contents.name: DiskTotal
contents.description: Total filesystem capacity at Parameters.MountPoint. MetricType=disk, MetricName=total.
contents.comment: Validation: v >= 0; effectively constant per filesystem.

contents.name: DiskAvailable
contents.description: Free space for non-privileged processes. MetricType=disk, MetricName=available.
contents.comment: Validation: 0 <= v <= DiskTotal.

contents.name: DiskFree
contents.description: Raw free space (includes root reserve). MetricType=disk, MetricName=free.
contents.comment: Validation: 0 <= v <= DiskTotal; DiskFree >= DiskAvailable.

contents.name: DiskUsed
contents.description: Used capacity = DiskTotal - DiskAvailable, floored at 0. MetricType=disk, MetricName=used.
contents.comment: Validation: 0 <= v <= DiskTotal.

contents.name: DiskUsagePercent
contents.description: Canonical disk-fullness signal. MetricType=disk, MetricName=usage_percent.
contents.comment: Validation: 0 <= v <= 100 (rounded to 2 dp); reject NaN / +-Inf. Warn at 80, critical at 95.

contents.name: DiskReadsCompleted
contents.description: Cumulative successful reads since boot. MetricType=disk, MetricName=reads_completed.
contents.comment: Validation: monotonic counter; delta(v) >= 0; resets only on reboot. Graph as IOPS.

contents.name: DiskWritesCompleted
contents.description: Cumulative successful writes since boot. MetricType=disk, MetricName=writes_completed.
contents.comment: Validation: monotonic counter; delta(v) >= 0; resets only on reboot. Graph as IOPS.

contents.name: DiskReadBytes
contents.description: Cumulative bytes read from underlying block device since boot. MetricType=disk, MetricName=read_bytes.
contents.comment: Validation: monotonic counter; delta(v) >= 0. Block-level; includes metadata / journal.

contents.name: DiskWrittenBytes
contents.description: Cumulative bytes written to underlying block device since boot. MetricType=disk, MetricName=written_bytes.
contents.comment: Validation: monotonic counter; delta(v) >= 0. Graph as throughput.

contents.name: NetworkBytesSent
contents.description: Cumulative L2 bytes transmitted on the interface since boot. MetricType=network, MetricName=bytes_sent. Bind via Parameters.Interface (v1.0) or Parameters.Interfaces (v1.1 array / auto-detect).
contents.comment: Validation: monotonic counter; delta(v) >= 0; resets only on reboot. Graph as rate(...) [bps].

contents.name: NetworkBytesReceived
contents.description: Cumulative L2 bytes received on the interface since boot. MetricType=network, MetricName=bytes_received. Bind via Parameters.Interface (v1.0) or Parameters.Interfaces (v1.1 array / auto-detect).
contents.comment: Validation: monotonic counter; delta(v) >= 0; resets only on reboot. Graph as rate(...) [bps].

contents.name: NetworkPacketsSent
contents.description: Cumulative TX frame count on the interface since boot. MetricType=network, MetricName=packets_sent. Bind via Parameters.Interface (v1.0) or Parameters.Interfaces (v1.1 array / auto-detect).
contents.comment: Validation: monotonic counter; delta(v) >= 0. Graph as rate(...) [pps].

contents.name: NetworkPacketsReceived
contents.description: Cumulative RX frame count on the interface since boot. MetricType=network, MetricName=packets_received. Bind via Parameters.Interface (v1.0) or Parameters.Interfaces (v1.1 array / auto-detect).
contents.comment: Validation: monotonic counter; delta(v) >= 0. Graph as rate(...) [pps].

contents.name: NetworkErrors
contents.description: Cumulative total network errors (errors_in + errors_out) on the interface since boot. MetricType=network, MetricName=errors. Bind via Parameters.Interface (v1.0) or Parameters.Interfaces (v1.1 array / auto-detect).
contents.comment: Validation: monotonic counter; delta(v) >= 0. Any sustained non-zero rate on Ethernet is abnormal.

contents.name: NetworkErrorsIn
contents.description: Cumulative receive errors (CRC / framing / FIFO drops). MetricType=network, MetricName=errors_in. Bind via Parameters.Interface (v1.0) or Parameters.Interfaces (v1.1 array / auto-detect).
contents.comment: Validation: monotonic counter; delta(v) >= 0. Non-zero rate typically signals layer-1 problems.

contents.name: NetworkErrorsOut
contents.description: Cumulative transmit errors (carrier loss / device failure). MetricType=network, MetricName=errors_out. Bind via Parameters.Interface (v1.0) or Parameters.Interfaces (v1.1 array / auto-detect).
contents.comment: Validation: monotonic counter; delta(v) >= 0. Non-zero rate signals carrier loss or device-side TX failure.

contents.name: SystemTime
contents.description: Host wall-clock time at sampling instant (Unix epoch seconds). MetricType=system, MetricName=time.
contents.comment: Validation: 1262304000 <= v < 4102444800 (2010-2100). Monotonic on healthy host; non-monotonic between samples indicates NTP step.

contents.name: SystemTimexOffset
contents.description: NTP offset between local clock and reference (seconds). MetricType=system, MetricName=timex_offset.
contents.comment: Validation: finite double; healthy |v| < 0.05; alert when |v| > 1.0 indicates NTP desync.

contents.name: SystemBootTime
contents.description: Host boot moment (Unix epoch seconds). MetricType=system, MetricName=boot_time.
contents.comment: Validation: 1262304000 <= v < 4102444800. Constant per boot; change between samples means the host rebooted.

contents.name: SystemFilefdAllocated
contents.description: Currently allocated kernel file descriptors. MetricType=system, MetricName=filefd_allocated.
contents.comment: Validation: 0 <= v <= SystemFilefdMaximum; alert when v / max > 0.8.

contents.name: SystemFilefdMaximum
contents.description: Kernel-wide max file descriptors. MetricType=system, MetricName=filefd_maximum.
contents.comment: Validation: v > 0; effectively constant.

contents.name: SystemProcsRunning
contents.description: Processes in R (runnable) state. MetricType=system, MetricName=procs_running.
contents.comment: Validation: v >= 0; sustained high indicates CPU contention.

contents.name: SystemProcsBlocked
contents.description: Processes in D (uninterruptible) state. MetricType=system, MetricName=procs_blocked.
contents.comment: Validation: v >= 0; sustained high indicates disk / NFS / driver stall.

contents.name: SystemIntrTotal
contents.description: Cumulative hardware interrupts since boot. MetricType=system, MetricName=intr_total.
contents.comment: Validation: monotonic counter; delta(v) >= 0. Always graph as rate.
